name: staircase
description: Staircase AI account intelligence for Claude. Turns the Staircase MCP into reliable workflows for CSMs, account managers, and CS leaders: book triage, account deep dive, meeting prep, risk check, follow-up draft, account handoff, renewal watchlist, risk radar, expansion scout, churn review, voice of customer, team manager, and manager 1:1 prep. Report-first and evidence-backed: structured Staircase reports for complete lists and rankings, then lifecycle events, communications, and verbatim evidence for the why. Resolves your book automatically on first use. Read-only; no CRM writes. Requires the Staircase AI connector.
